title: Logistics and Custody (SYNTHETIC TEST DATA)

list.name: shipment
list.label: Shipment
list.query: SELECT shipment_id FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_SHIPMENTS ORDER BY shipment_id
list.definition: SELECT shipment_id FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_SHIPMENTS ORDER BY shipment_id

options.content: **Default range = the complete synthetic dataset (2021-01-01 → today)** so every shipment's readings are visible immediately — including 2021–2025 shipments. To zoom into one shipment's observation window, narrow the **time picker** (top right). A panel showing *"Data outside time range"* means rows exist but sit outside the visible window — not missing data and not a query failure. 'No readings in the selected time range' under a chart means the query succeeded but the window has no rows.

panels.title: Shipment timeline
panels.description: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — generated dataset 2021–Oct 2026; not real vehicle observations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT shipment_id, cargo_type, pallets, vehicle_id, departed_at, expected_arrival_at, arrived_at, receiver_verdict, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, expected_arrival_at, arrived_at) AS delay_minutes FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_SHIPMENTS WHERE shipment_id='$shipment'

panels.title: Delivery acceptance outcomes (all shipments)
panels.description: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — generated dataset 2021–Oct 2026; not real vehicle observations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT receiver_verdict AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_SHIPMENTS GROUP BY receiver_verdict

panels.title: Custody handoffs
panels.description: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — generated dataset 2021–Oct 2026; not real vehicle observations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT handoff_no, received_by, handed_at, seal_intact FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_CUSTODY WHERE shipment_id='$shipment' ORDER BY handoff_no

panels.title: Speed (km/h) — modeled GPS route data
panels.description: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — generated dataset 2021–Oct 2026; not real vehicle observations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS time, speed_kmh FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY WHERE shipment_id='$shipment' AND speed_kmh IS NOT NULL ORDER BY recorded_at

panels.noValue: No readings in the selected time range — widen the time picker (full range 2021–2026).

panels.title: Fuel level % and traffic congestion (synthetic/modeled values)
panels.description: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — generated dataset 2021–Oct 2026; not real vehicle observations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS time, fuel_level_pct FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY WHERE shipment_id='$shipment' AND fuel_level_pct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY recorded_at

panels.noValue: No readings in the selected time range — widen the time picker (full range 2021–2026).

panels.title: Traffic congestion index (modeled)
panels.description: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — generated dataset 2021–Oct 2026; not real vehicle observations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS time, traffic_congestion FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY WHERE shipment_id='$shipment' AND traffic_congestion IS NOT NULL ORDER BY recorded_at

panels.noValue: No readings in the selected time range — widen the time picker (full range 2021–2026).

panels.title: Route GPS trace (synthetic route model)
panels.description: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — generated dataset 2021–Oct 2026; not real vehicle observations.

targets.rawSql: SELECT TOP 500 latitude AS lat, longitude AS lon, recorded_at FROM FDE_VIEWS.VW_TELEMETRY WHERE shipment_id='$shipment' AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY recorded_at

panels.noValue: No GPS points in the selected time range — widen the picker (full range 2021–2026).
